models_evaluated: Improved autonomous AI system for diabetic retinal disease (previously FDA-authorized, adapted for RetinaVue700 handheld camera)

links.outcome: AI sensitivity and specificity across racial, ethnic, and sex subgroups before deployment
links.effect: All prespecified non-inferiority endpoints were met and no racial, ethnic or sex bias was identified in 626 participants (45.7% Hispanic, 17.3% Black).
links.quote: all prespecified non-inferiority endpoints were met and no racial, ethnic or sex bias was identified, against a Wisconsin Reading Center level I prognostic standard using widefield stereoscopic photography and macular Optical Coherence Tomography.

screen.reason: This prospective trial evaluates the clinical performance, safety, and demographic equity of an updated autonomous AI diagnostic system for diabetic retinal disease adapted for a handheld camera in primary care settings.
